default.description: Default value; may use ${{ }} referring to earlier arguments

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match (string, secret)

required.description: Fail (or prompt) when no value is given

by-flavor.description: Value per flavor name, based-on, family or default

based-on.description: Built-in flavor a custom flavor derives from

cloud-image.description: Cloud image URL for VM builds

path.description: Glob (relative to the repository for git imports)

dest.description: Absolute destination (directory if it ends with / or the source is a directory/glob)

mode.description: Mode for files (default: keep the local mode)

source.description: Local file, directory or glob, relative to the configuration file

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit to check out

regex.description: Extended regular expression selecting the line to replace or remove

state.description: present or absent (default: present) One of: present, absent.

format.description: File format One of: json, yaml, ini, env.

key.description: Key; dot separated path for json and yaml (a.b.0.c)

path.description: Absolute path of the file (created when missing)

section.description: INI section (empty for the top level)

value.description: Value; any YAML value for json and yaml

source.description: Template file, relative to the configuration file

append.description: Append the content unless it is already present (default: false)

source.description: Local file, relative to the configuration file
Local script file, relative to the configuration file

sudo.description: Grant sudo rights (sudo group on Debian/Ubuntu, wheel on Arch) (default: false)

source.description: Local file with public keys, relative to the configuration file

remove-home.description: Also remove the home directory and mail spool (default: false)

expire.description: Force a password change at first login (default: false)

hash.description: Password hash as produced by mkpasswd/openssl passwd

password.description: Plain text password (use a secret argument)

random.description: Generate a random password and print it (default: false)

apt.description: apt settings: uri (required), suites (default: the release codename), components (default: main), key (armored key), key-url, architectures

pacman.description: pacman settings: server (required), sig-level, key-id, keyserver

source.description: Local package file, copied to /var/cache/osb first
Local package list file (# comments allowed)

device.description: Device, UUID=..., LABEL=... or remote path

mount.description: Mount immediately on live systems (default: true)

charset.description: Character set used in locale.gen (default: UTF-8)

url.description: Download the certificate from this URL

restart.description: Restart the unit on live systems (default: false)

name.description: Unit name including suffix, e.g. app.service

start.description: (Re)start the unit on live systems (default: false)

now.description: Also stop the units on live systems (default: false)
Also start the units on live systems (default: false)

level.description: info or warn (default: info) One of: info, warn.

message.description: Message (default: a reboot is required to complete the configuration)

allow-skip-checksums.description: Allow sources without checksums (e.g. VCS packages: they are not pinned) (default: false)

build-user.description: Unprivileged user that builds the packages (default: osb-aur)

commit.description: Full commit hash of the AUR repository

packages.description: Packages of a split package to install (default: all) (default: [])

pgp-keys.description: Full fingerprints of the keys in the PKGBUILD's validpgpkeys (default: [])

settings.description: List of {file, group, key, value}; group may be a list for nested groups

cn.description: Common name of the self-signed certificate (default: the host name) (default: )

name.description: Name of the launcher in /usr/local/bin and of the user service (<name>.service) (default: krdp-session)

deploy-hook.description: Shell script run after every issuance/renewal (default: )

paths.description: Paths relative to the home directory

file.description: File for a generated password (default: /root/${{ args.user }}-password)

target.description: Target that wants the unit (default: default.target)

unit.description: Absolute path of the unit file

name.description: Unit name including suffix, e.g. app.service

creates.description: Skip the step at run time if this path exists

foreach.description: Repeat the step for each item (item, index)

if.description: JavaScript condition evaluated at generation time

name.description: Step name, used to reference outputs (steps[name].output)

on-error.description: What to do when the step fails at run time

only-if.description: Run-time shell condition; the step runs only if it succeeds

output.description: Output values available to later steps

post-validation.description: JavaScript assertion evaluated after rendering (sees output and rendered)

pre-script.description: JavaScript run before rendering; its global variables are visible in templates

packages.description: Packages installed if missing, or a mapping of flavor to packages

unless.description: Run-time shell condition; the step is skipped if it succeeds

run.description: Run the generated shell script in a container (osb test --run)

cloud-init.description: The #cloud-config user-data: osb render cloud-init, and the configuration of the qcow2 and ova build VMs.

extra.description: cloud-config merged into the generated user-data: new keys are added, lists are appended to osb's lists (for example runcmd entries run after osb's), and other values replace osb's.

hostname.description: Host name, set with cloud-init's hostname module. A set-hostname step takes precedence.

dockerfile.description: The self-contained Dockerfile: osb render dockerfile, and the base of oci and wsl.

base-image.description: Image for FROM. It must belong to the flavor's distribution family. Default: the flavor's image: ubuntu:24.04, debian:13, archlinux:latest.

cmd.description: CMD: a list is written in exec form, a string in shell form. Default: ["/bin/bash"] when neither cmd nor entrypoint is set.

entrypoint.description: ENTRYPOINT: a list is written in exec form (["/usr/bin/tini", "--"]), a string in shell form.

env.description: Environment variables, written as ENV right after FROM: available to all steps and in the running container.

expose.description: Ports for EXPOSE, e.g. [80, 443/tcp, 53/udp]. Documentation only: publish them with docker run -p.

labels.description: Additional LABELs. osb always sets org.opencontainers.image.title (the configuration's name) and org.opencontainers.image.description.

merge-steps.description: Merge consecutive steps without secrets into one RUN, so that a file changed by several steps is stored once and the image has fewer layers. false gives one RUN per step, so a changed step rebuilds less. Default: true.

package-cache.description: How package downloads and lists stay out of the image. tmpfs: RUNs that use the package manager mount a temporary file system over the cache directories (--mount=type=tmpfs); it lives in memory, so very large installations need enough RAM. cache: a BuildKit cache mount that keeps the downloads on the builder between builds, for fast rebuilds. remove: delete the caches at the end of each RUN. One of: tmpfs, cache, remove. Default: tmpfs.

slim.description: Leave out documentation: man and info pages (and on Debian and Ubuntu docs and translations, keeping the copyright files) of the packages installed by the steps; each RUN also removes /tmp, /var/tmp, /root/.cache and the package manager logs. Default: false.

user.description: USER at the end of the file: the user the container runs as. All steps run as root before it.

workdir.description: WORKDIR at the end of the file: the working directory of the container.

oci.description: osb build oci: builds the Dockerfile into a container image. builder and platform are also used by wsl.

archive.description: Additionally save the image to this tar file (docker save). A relative path is relative to the output directory.

builder.description: Container CLI that builds (and saves and pushes) the image. docker needs BuildKit, the default since Docker 23. One of: docker, podman. Default: docker.

platform.description: Build for another platform, e.g. linux/arm64 (--platform). Building for a foreign architecture needs QEMU emulation (binfmt).

push.description: Push all tags after the build. Log in to the registry first (docker login). Default: false.

tags.description: Image names, e.g. ["registry.example.com/devbox:${{ flavor.name }}", devbox:latest]. Default: <name>:<flavor>.

ova.description: osb build ova: builds the qcow2 image (with artifacts.qcow2) and packages it as <name>-<flavor>.ova for VMware and VirtualBox.

cpus.description: Number of CPUs of the virtual machine, written to the OVF. Default: 2.

memory.description: Memory of the virtual machine in MiB, written to the OVF (the build VM uses artifacts.qcow2.memory). Default: 2048.

name.description: Name of the virtual machine in the OVF descriptor. Default: <name>-<flavor>.

os-type.description: VMware guest OS identifier; VirtualBox maps it to its own OS type. Default: per flavor: ubuntu64Guest, debian11_64Guest, other5xLinux64Guest.

qcow2.description: osb build qcow2: boots a cloud image with the configuration as cloud-init and saves the disk as <name>-<flavor>.qcow2. ova builds with these settings, too.

base-image.description: URL or path of a cloud image with cloud-init; a relative path is relative to the configuration. Downloads are cached for 7 days in ~/.cache/osb/images. Default: the flavor's official cloud image (Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13 genericcloud, Arch Linux cloudimg).

compress.description: Compress the image (qemu-img convert -c): a smaller file, slightly slower first reads. Default: true.

cpus.description: Number of CPUs of the build VM. Default: 2.

disk-size.description: Virtual size of the disk (qemu-img sizes: 512M, 20G). The cloud image grows its root file system to it on boot. Default: 10G.

driver.description: qemu runs qemu-system-x86_64 directly (with KVM when /dev/kvm is usable); libvirt creates a transient domain with virsh. One of: qemu, libvirt. Default: qemu.

libvirt-uri.description: libvirt connection for driver: libvirt, e.g. qemu:///system. Default: qemu:///session.

memory.description: Memory of the build VM in MiB. Default: 2048.

sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 checksum of the base image; the build fails on a mismatch.

timeout.description: Maximum duration of the build VM run, e.g. 90s, 45m, 1h30m. Default: 30m.

shell.description: The generated POSIX shell script: osb render shell, osb apply and the run script inside cloud-init.

colors.description: Color the messages (steps, warnings, errors) when the script runs in a terminal. Without it, the script contains no terminal handling at all. Default: false.

wsl.description: osb build wsl: builds the image like oci, adds the WSL configuration and exports <name>-<flavor>.wsl.

default-user.description: User that WSL logs in as ([user] default in /etc/wsl.conf). Create the user with add-user. Default: root.

hostname.description: Host name of the distribution ([network] hostname). Default: the Windows computer name.

name.description: Distribution name that wsl --install --from-file suggests ([oobe] defaultName in /etc/wsl-distribution.conf). Default: the configuration's name.

systemd.description: Boot the distribution with systemd ([boot] systemd), so services run. systemd is installed when the image does not have it. Default: true.

name.description: Name used for images and output files
